## Round-3 duties and limits

The correction diff changes eleven case bodies in six test files, with no executable shared helper, fixture, snapshot, production, or runner change. The added supporting-LLM intake path covers the already inventoried model-pinning case; no extra identity or unrelated case was introduced. Static review of the correction hunks found no incidental rendered-text count, tag-absence proxy, or unsupported order assertion. The added exactly-one audit assertion states the actual single-write audit contract.

Sibling search used `toHaveBeenCalledTimes\(|toContain\(|toHaveLength\(|\.not\.toContain\(|toneBefore|new-review-uuid|task\.outputSchema ===|resetAccountDefault|corr-import-(terminal|idempotent-first)` across those six files, then compared matches against the immutable correction diff. Both returned-ID siblings, both captured-tone cases, both local-policy seed cases and both explicit-first-import cases are included. Unchanged neighboring cases, helpers and historical exclusions stay outside this corrective round; no new defect was established within the authorized hunks and their affected assertions.

The correction hunks add no operational failure emitter or actionable alert path, and change no live runbook or plan claim. Prior duties 2/3/5 dispositions remain historical and unchanged. No browser, external provider, remote database, or Sentry configuration/delivery action was performed by this verifier. Root's browser and alert work is separate evidence. A killed mutant establishes the fault and assertion described in its row; it does not prove later assertions that the failed run never reaches.
